description: Add active project context selection and project-aware answer routing so technical interview questions about the current project can be answered using a cached repository summary instead of only generic retrieval.

userStories.title: Add active project path state and CLI controls
userStories.description: As the user, I want to set and inspect the active project directory so that project-specific interview answers can target the repository I care about right now.
acceptanceCriteria: The bot state store persists an active project path independently from retrieval mode and Telegram offset state
CLI commands let the user set the active project path and inspect the current active project selection
Invalid or non-directory paths fail clearly without corrupting existing state
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Keep the first version local-first and CLI-driven. No frontend is required.

userStories.title: Build cached project context summaries
userStories.description: As the user, I want the system to summarize the active project into structured facts so that answers can reference the real repository without rescanning everything on every question.
acceptanceCriteria: A workflow can scan the active project directory and produce a structured project context artifact
The summary captures at least project overview, tech stack, memory-related implementation hints, retrieval-related implementation hints, orchestration flow, storage, and key files
Project context artifacts are cached locally and can be refreshed on demand
Scanning avoids reading arbitrary system directories outside the configured project path
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Favor deterministic summaries from a bounded set of files such as README, package metadata, AGENTS, and targeted source files over dumping raw source into prompts.

userStories.title: Route project-related questions through project context
userStories.description: As the user, I want project-specific interview questions to automatically pull in the active project context so that answers about memory, retrieval, architecture, or workers reflect the current repository.
acceptanceCriteria: The answer workflow classifies whether a question needs project context, general retrieval, or both
Project-related questions include cached project context in the answer-generation prompt
Non-project questions continue to use the existing retrieval flow without requiring an active project
Mixed questions can use both project context and retrieved historical QA when both are relevant
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use a stable rule-first router and only add lightweight model help where needed. Keep the integration incremental inside existing LangGraph workflows.

userStories.title: Add Telegram project switching and refresh commands
userStories.description: As the user, I want to switch or refresh the active project from Telegram so that the resident worker can stay in sync without requiring a separate local shell for every project change.
acceptanceCriteria: The Telegram one-shot workflow recognizes exact project control commands without breaking normal content processing
A project path command can update the active project path and reply with the new selection status
A refresh command can rebuild the cached project context for the active project and report success or failure
Project control command failures are reported clearly and do not advance unrelated content bundles
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Keep the command format explicit and conservative, similar to the retrieval mode commands.

userStories.title: Document project-aware answering workflow
userStories.description: As the user, I want the new project-context commands and behavior documented so that I can reliably use project-aware answers in the CLI and Telegram worker.
acceptanceCriteria: README documents the active project commands, cache refresh behavior, and when project context is injected into answers
Documentation makes clear that the first implementation is backend-only and does not require a frontend
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Keep docs aligned with the exact commands shipped in this branch.
